name: AvatarTest-v1
why: GUAVA's 58-ID test set is not released; every model (GUAVA, GUAVA-FB, ExAvatar, GaussianAvatar, GART, ...) is run on these clips and frames instead of copying numbers from a different split.

protocol.frames: per clip, the ordered list 'frames' (GT available on every one); n_recon = floor(n / 2)
protocol.source: source_frame = frames[0]; single-image methods (GUAVA, GUAVA-FB) see only this frame
protocol.recon: frames[:n_recon] (recon_frames = first / last); per-subject methods (ExAvatar, GaussianAvatar, GART) may train on these frames only (GUAVA Table 2: 'first half of each video for their training')
protocol.test: test_frames = frames[n_recon:]; every method is scored on exactly these frames
protocol.driving: GT rows: the GT SMPL-X of each test frame (+ GT camera); estimator rows (e.g. SPRINT): the estimator's per-frame output on the same frames; the source avatar of an estimator row is built from the estimator's fit of the source frame
protocol.metrics: GUAVA main/metrics.py: PSNR, L1 (MAE), SSIM, LPIPS-VGG on the 512 x 512 person crop; GT = image x person mask on black; mean per clip, then frame-weighted over clips; per dataset and overall
protocol.mask: StyleMatte (EHM-Tracker pretrained/matting/stylematte_synth.pt) on the 1024 crop, as GUAVA's data
protocol.crop: GUAVA-FB perspective body crop (FORMAT.md): square, 1.1 x the long side of the GT-mesh box, 1024 px
protocol.recon_time: avatar creation from the source (ms, CUDA-synchronised), plus the pose fit of the source frame for estimator rows; per-subject methods: their training time on the recon frames

composition.selection: C1 split (seed 20261015, round-robin over scenes; clips 150-450 frames at 30 fps, 720 px high; one clip per identity), minus clips with fewer than 60 GT frames of the subject

composition.pool: BEDLAM2 SPRINT / PEAR-student val jobs (20240731_1_1827_hdri static HDRI, 20240808_1_250_ai1105_vcam moving camera)
composition.selection: bedlam_split_proposal.json test: subjects by SHA-1 hash, one clip per subject (most full-body rows), MOYO excluded

not_used.reason: all 32 subjects are in GUAVA-FB training (28) or validation / checkpoint selection (4)
dataset SMPL-X labels are poorly aligned (27 of 1,500 audited clips pass the alignment filter); the usable labels are SPRINT refits, which would favour the SPRINT row
SPRINT trained on 9 of 10 subjects and selects on s10; hand-object scenes
single performer, also a BEDLAM2 training body; val takes used for SPRINT selection

caveats: UBody GT is pseudo-GT (UBody's own SMPL-X fits), not motion capture.
Released GUAVA was trained on undisclosed UBody clips: the UBody part is held out for our models, not provably for GUAVA.

BEDLAM2 test subjects never appear in GUAVA-FB data; SPRINT trained on other BEDLAM2 jobs (see per-clip checks.subject_in_sprint_training_jobs) and selected checkpoints on the val jobs these clips come from.
No real full-body footage with true GT SMPL-X is included (candidate for v2: X-Humans, needs registration and a download).

licences.ubody: UBody (IDEA Research, OSX): research use only
licences.bedlam2: BEDLAM2: MPI non-commercial scientific research licence (Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; https://bedlam2.is.tuebingen.mpg.de/license.html). Research use only; no redistribution. Body model: SMPL-X 2020 (MPI non-commercial licence).
